{
  "name": "decision-tracker",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Keeps decisions mentioned in replies in a band above the prompt until they are written to your decision log.",
  "author": {
    "name": "i-noma-ru",
    "url": "https://github.com/i-noma-ru"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/i-noma-ru/claude-decision-tracker",
  "repository": "https://github.com/i-noma-ru/claude-decision-tracker",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "decisions",
    "band",
    "ui"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "keywords": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Decision keywords",
      "description": "A sentence that contains any of these (case-insensitive) is kept as a decision.",
      "default": [
        "we decided",
        "decided to",
        "decision:",
        "agreed to",
        "going with",
        "裁定",
        "に決めました",
        "と決めました",
        "に決定",
        "を採用します",
        "を採用しました"
      ]
    },
    "record_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Decision log path",
      "description": "A successful Edit or Write whose file path contains this string clears the band.",
      "default": "docs/decisions/"
    },
    "max_items": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Maximum kept decisions",
      "description": "Oldest decisions are dropped beyond this count.",
      "default": 20,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 50
    }
  }
}
